name: Partial Spearman Correlation
aliases: Partial Spearman Correlation for Confound Control
definition: A statistical method to determine if the association between cross-seed instability ($\sigma_{ens}$) and ensemble mean error ($\epsilon_{mean}$) persists after controlling for an oracle inverse-emissivity proxy ($\bar{E}$), treating low-emissivity regions as a signal-strength confound.
